decisions.executionNote: Establish continuous elbow-up approach on both sides. Plan cars in white, cameras in blue, green watches in red; geometry estimated from RGB.
Pitch grippers toward top-down and approach cyan car with left and right-side camera with right, above contact height.
Lower toward car and camera while turning jaws to their narrow dimensions; right camera requires a small forward correction. Inspect before closing.
Retry corrected tensor from unchanged observation: center jaws and close on car and camera, then inspect retention.
Lift with both grippers closed to verify retention, then start moving car toward white basket and camera toward blue.
Car visibly retained; move it over white basket. Right camera is on table, so reopen and realign over its changed orientation rather than transport empty gripper.
Release cyan car inside white and withdraw. Correct right camera approach backward using projected surface contact and lower with jaws open.
Car released in white. Approach gold car with left. Use right wrist image to correct camera centering forward/right, then close at low height.
Lift the regrasped right camera with closed jaws to test retention. Lower left above gold car and align jaws to its body before closing.
Right camera visibly retained; transport toward right half of blue basket. Close left on centered gold car after a small descent, then test lift.
Replan after continuity rejection: smaller inward steps while lowering right to reduce joint excursion. Lift gold car vertically with left to inspect retention.
Gold car retained; carry toward white. Right near IK boundary: retreat slightly and reduce downward pitch to recover reach margin while keeping camera closed over blue edge.
Previous act executed zero. Recover right arm away from singular boundary with submillimeter retreat and very small pitch increments; continue left carry cautiously.
With right reach margin recovered, shift camera safely inward over blue. Bring gold car over white while retaining both objects.
Release right camera over blue. Replan left after continuity guard: retreat slightly and pitch toward basket to gain reach without extending the arm further.
Open left over white and withdraw; both cars appear within the basket but need settling. Approach remaining left camera and right watch with open jaws.
Lower and center above remaining camera and front-right watch, using wrist views to refine near-vertical approaches.
Close left around camera after shallow descent. Correct watch centering forward from wrist view and close right, then begin a small retention-test lift.
Lift camera and watch with closed jaws and verify retention before carrying. Begin a modest forward pitch to keep basket approaches within reach.
Left camera retained; carry toward blue with forward pitch. Right watch remained on table, so reopen and recenter backward over the loop for a deeper grasp.
Position left camera over blue interior without full extension. Refine right watch grasp using observed wrist-image motion: shift back/right and descend slightly before closing.
Release second camera in blue and withdraw left. Correct watch approach based on actual wrist displacement, reversing the mistaken lateral direction before regrasping.
Cameras appear together in blue; retract left within its workspace. Close right on now-centered watch loop after a shallow descent and test lift.
Test watch retention with vertical lift. Begin smooth left wrist unwinding and retraction toward origin while keeping elbow-up continuity.
Watch lift showed no retention. Reopen and descend with a small lateral correction from wrist-image alignment; finish left return smoothly.
Watch loop is now centered within the closing corridor. Close without lateral motion and start a small test lift; settle left at origin.
Watch still on table. Reopen and reposition using head projection of the fingertip offset rather than apparent wrist-image center; shift backward and slightly right.
Refine watch placement midway between previous wrist-image offsets and close slowly with no translation during contact.
Test whether the watch face is captured between fingertips by lifting vertically before any basket transport.
Watch now visibly follows the right gripper. Carry to red with a forward pitch; prepare left to retrieve the remaining central-left watch without crossing arms.
Watch slipped during transport; reapproach its new table position with open right jaws. Position left above the other watch, aiming to grip the solid face rather than only the band.
Advance both open grippers toward the watches based on wrist-image displacement, keeping fixed orientation for a more stable face grasp.
Aim for the solid watch faces rather than empty band centers: lower left and move right face into fingertip corridor, then close both without lifting yet.
Allow both grippers to finish closing, then lift slowly and vertically to assess actual watch retention before transport.
Both watches visibly follow grippers. Carry right toward red without wrist rotation; stage left watch at the center boundary for later right-arm retrieval rather than crossing arms.
Set left watch gently on the central handoff area and open. Advance retained right watch over red interior, pitching slowly for reach margin.
Release right watch inside red and withdraw. Clear left arm from the staged watch, smoothly returning toward origin before right-arm retrieval.
One watch settled in red. Retract left and approach staged final watch from the right with a slight inward fingertip tilt, keeping arms separated.
Finish left return. Lower right over final watch at center staging area, maintaining inward fingertip tilt and right-side wrist position.
Center final watch laterally and lower to the previously successful grasp height. Close slowly with the wrist remaining on the right side.
Finish closing and test final-watch retention with a slow vertical lift; avoid transporting until RGB confirms it follows.
Final watch follows the gripper by its band. Raise for clearance and begin slow rightward carry without rotating the wrist.
Continue steady carry of retained final watch toward red, adding clearance above the basket rim and keeping wrist orientation fixed.
Move final retained watch into the red basket interior, introducing only a slow forward pitch to preserve reach margin.
Release final watch over red and allow it to settle, then withdraw upward/backward with open gripper before returning to origin.
All six objects appear grouped in their baskets. Return right arm smoothly toward origin with gripper open; maintain elbow-up continuity and monitor settling.
Continue open-gripper return toward origin, slowing before the final configuration. Baskets visibly contain cars, cameras, and watches separately.
